Strategy: Widen the best pure bonus band to twenty-five to forty-five, dropping the penalty entirely after the penalty-free version beat the penalized one. It may help by covering more good placements, but may fail by diluting the band with looser bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 25 and r - item <= 45 else 0) for r in bins]
```
